verdicts.reasoning: Every seed requires calculating a difference or remaining portion, formulated directly as subtraction (e.g., 1830 - 1744), as "moves backward" on a number line, or as deducing the missing "other part" in a NumberBond.
All numerical components provided in the items are positive whole numbers smaller than 10,000, topping out at 6525 in seed 78.
The problems comprise examples of subtraction that inherently require regrouping (like 1830 - 1744 in seed 42) alongside those that can be solved without regrouping (like 6525 - 4125 in seed 78).
